conviction_note: The Q3 revenue and cash numbers were pre-released on 2026-10-16, so the print mostly brings the cash path. The new information all comes from the financing trail since then: a $50M Yorkville SEPA (2026-11-12), shares issued and resold from 2026-11-18, and a special meeting moved to 07:00 ET on the print morning that will approve a 1:20-1:50 reverse split plus 200M more authorised shares. Q2 is the precedent: it was also pre-released with a going-concern warning and still fell about 19% premarket on the print. The stock is already down 35% in 20 days and trades at about the cash it had at 2026-09-30, which is why p_up is 40 and not lower. abs_move 15 is roughly one day of the 236% realised vol. -3.0 = (2*0.40-1)*15. The findings sum to -3.5; the two measurements agree in sign and size.
bar: Revenue bar = company preliminary Q3 revenue $4.3-4.4M and cash ~$26.0M (6-K / release 2026-10-16, https://finviz.com/news/403663/nanox-provides-business-update-and-furnishes-certain-preliminary-unaudited-financial-data-for-third-quarter-ended-september-30-2026). The aggregator consensus is stale and pre-dates the pre-release: revenue $5.44M / EPS -$0.15 (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/NNOX/estimates) and $5.5M / -$0.14 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/NNOX/earnings-forecasts). A headline 'miss' of about 20% against that stale consensus is mechanical and already public (Earnings Whispers preview, https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/NNOX/23257). No revenue or cash guidance exists; the only quantitative guide is the 25-30% annualised opex cut by end of Q1 2027 (6-K 2026-11-09).
positioning_check: Short interest 5.78M shares at the 2026-10-30 settlement, 5.9 days to cover on the ADV of the time (https://massive.com/quote/nnox.md). That is about 7.2% of 80.4M shares outstanding. At the baseline's 20-day ADV of 6.1M it is about 1 day to cover, so not a crowded short and no squeeze mechanism to shrink the negatives for. Options: chain unusable (OI 444, put/call OI 0.1, no two-sided ATM quotes), so there is no skew and no implied move. Tape: spot $0.2076 is the 52-week low, -27.9% over 5 days, -35.3% over 20 days, -95.4% from the 52-week high. Yorkville holds 9.9% (8.64M shares including SEPA shares, 13G event 2026-11-12) and resells. Activist Moshe Moalem holds 8.33% (13D/A 2026-11-12) and is now settled with the board.

findings.finding: On 2026-11-12 Nanox signed two Standby Equity Purchase Agreements with Yorkville (YA II PN) for up to $50M of ordinary shares: $10M primary plus $40M resale. They are priced at 97% of the lowest daily VWAP over a 3-day pricing period, each advance capped at the greater of 5-day ADV or $2.5M, with a 9.99% ownership blocker. The first 725,600 shares were issued on 2026-11-18 at $0.3132 for $227k. Shares outstanding are 80,388,806. With a market cap of about $16.7M at $0.2076, the $50M facility is about 3x the equity value. Asked what the money buys: it funds a burn of about $14M a quarter (Q2 operating outflow $25.5M for H1; Q3 cash went from $31.4M plus $8.5M raised to $26.0M). Management said in Q2 there was 'no material change' in ARC systems in deployment, so no demand ramp is corroborated. The going-concern doubt stands. Yorkville's resale is a continuing mechanical seller through the print window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock went from $0.318 on 2026-11-12 (the SEPA date, per the 424B5) to $0.225 on 2026-11-20 and $0.2076 on 2026-11-24, about -35%, while the Yorkville resale began. The August 2026 $8M registered direct at $1.00 preceded a fall to $0.75 after the Q2 print.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the 35% fall since 2026-11-12 is that pricing. If it were fully priced, Yorkville would be done selling, and it is not. The 424B5 of 2026-11-23 shows advances still being drawn, and the $40M resale tranche only opens once the share authorisation passes on 2026-11-25. Advance pricing at 97% of the lowest VWAP rewards the investor for selling into weakness on the print day. There is no option market to express it, and coverage is about 2 analysts.
findings.independence: The 424B5 of 2026-11-23 is a separate document confirming advance shares issued and resold (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1795251/000121390026122954/ea0313197-424b5_nanox.htm). The Yorkville 13G at 9.9% is a third (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1795251/000110465926127043/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml). All three describe the same facility, so they count once.

findings.finding: The special general meeting was moved from 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-25 at 07:00 ET, the morning of the print. It votes on: (1) 200M additional authorised shares, taking the total to 350M against 80.4M outstanding (cut from the original +300M after activist pressure); (2) a reverse split framework of 1:20 to 1:50, with the ratio at the board's discretion within 18 months, aimed at the Nasdaq bid-price deadline of 2027-03-29; (3) a two-thirds board vote needed to remove the chairman. Activist Moalem (8.33%) agreed on 2026-11-11 to vote for (1) and (2), so approval is likely, and the 6-K result lands inside the window. The approval triggers Yorkville's remaining $125k of commitment shares and lets the $40M resale SEPA run. The positive read: the delisting risk falls and a proxy fight is settled (Meltzer stepped down as chairman 2026-11-11; two activist directors were added).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reverse split by this name. When the meeting notice and the 1:20-1:50 range first appeared (6-K 2026-10-28, stock $0.321 on 10-27), the stock drifted to $0.23 by 2026-11-09. Not cleanly attributable.
findings.why_not_priced: The vote is public. What is not yet known is that it passed, the ratio the board picks (1:50 at $0.21 gives about $10.4) and whether the board announces it with the print. If the approval were priced, the stock would not have kept making new lows into the meeting. A share authorisation more than 4x the outstanding count is the capacity for the next dilution round.
findings.independence: Activist 13D of 2026-10-29, opposing the original +300M increase as excessive dilution (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1795251/000117891326004909/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml). Original proxy of 2026-10-28 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795251/000121390026113380/ea030999302ex99-1.htm). Same meeting, separate documents. Shares the Yorkville linkage with finding 1 only through the commitment-share trigger.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue and cash were pre-released on 2026-10-16: revenue $4.3-4.4M (teleradiology $3.1M flat, imaging systems/OEM $0.3M, AI/software $1.0M mostly from the acquired Health IT), against $4.2M in Q2 and $3.4M a year earlier. Cash, deposits and restricted deposits were about $26.0M against $60.0M at end-2025. That implies a Q3 burn of about $13.9M ($31.4M + $8.5M raised - $26.0M). At that rate about $12M remains at year-end before SEPA draws. The reported-quarter line lands inside what the company already told the market. What the print can add is the cash walk and October-November burn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-10-16 pre-release with going-concern language fell more than 10% (RTTNews headline 'stock down over 10%', https://www.rttnews.com/3700239/nano-x-addresses-going-concern-in-preliminary-q3-update-stock-down-over-10.aspx). The July 2026 Q2 pre-release was followed by a print that still fell about 19% premarket.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the revenue and quarter-end cash are public. Only the burn arithmetic and the post-quarter cash are new. The market cap (~$16.7M) sitting below the September cash ($26M) shows the market already discounts at least two more quarters of burn.
findings.independence: Q2 release cash and raise figures (https://finviz.com/news/390171/nanox-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides-business-updates). Same company documents, different period.

findings.finding: Possible further non-cash impairment in Q3 GAAP. At June 30 equity was $72.5M (424B5 capitalisation table) against a market cap now about $16.7M (80.4M shares x $0.2076). The 2026-11-09 plan evaluates 'divestitures, reduced activity, or discontinuation' of South Korea operations (the idled chip line). The Q2 impairment ($40.7M on AI intangibles) was triggered explicitly by the share-price decline, which has since run from about $0.93 to $0.21. Unquantified and not pre-released.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 print on 2026-09-09 carried the $40.7M impairment plus a revenue miss and fell about 19% premarket to $0.75 from a $0.93 close (https://allmind.ai/news/002c12e7b3518ac674d18ef7e96032b6f43880c77306d6c081117fdc81e90d2b), even though Q2 revenue and cash had been pre-released on 2026-07-23 (https://longbridge.com/news/293673280).
findings.why_not_priced: The pre-release of 2026-10-16 gave only revenue and cash, with no P&L or impairment; the Q2 pre-release explicitly reserved 'impairment assessments'. If it were priced, the market would be treating the Q2 precedent (a pre-released quarter still falling about 19%) as irrelevant. This is an inference from the market-cap/book gap, not a company statement, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The equity figure comes from the 424B5 of 2026-11-13 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1795251/000121390026119219/ea0312036-424b5_nanox.htm). The CFO said in Q2 there was 'no visibility' into further charges (call summary, https://www.webull.com/news/15551848870096896).

findings.finding: The 2026-11-09 board-approved plan targets a 25-30% cut in annualised 2026 GAAP and non-GAAP opex by end of Q1 2027, including a global workforce reduction and the ~$2M Korea savings. Headcount, restructuring charge and burn trajectory were not quantified. The call is the first chance to put a cash-burn number on it, which could lengthen the implied runway against a ~$14M/quarter burn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-11-09 announcement closed at $0.23, -2.75% (RTTNews), so the plan itself bought nothing. The Korea savings first given with Q2 did not stop the about -19% print reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: The percentage is public but the dollar burn is not. If the market credited it, the stock would not trade near the September cash balance while it burns $14M a quarter. Restructuring payments raise near-term outflow (the company's own caveat), so the upside is capped.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: spot $0.2076 is the 52-week low after -27.9% in 5 sessions and -35.3% in 20, on a 20-day ADV of 6.1M shares (about 7.6% of shares a day). Short interest was 5.78M at 2026-10-30, about 7% of shares and about 1 day of current volume. The market cap of about $16.7M is below September-30 cash of $26M. findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean record of a bounce on a print. Q2 and the Q3 pre-release both fell.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely a statement that the stock has already fallen. The drawdown has an identified cause (Yorkville resale), so this is mostly priced. It is kept small because the extension and the below-cash market cap are measurable.

baseline_tension: There is no skew and no implied move to agree or disagree with. The negative lean agrees with the -35% 20-day run-up and the 52-week-low tape, so most of the financing story is priced. The residual is the Yorkville selling that continues and the dilution capacity unlocked on the print morning. That is why p_up is 40 and not 30.
lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what the SEPA money buys. It funds about $14M/quarter of burn with 'no material change' in ARC deployments and a going-concern flag, so the negative sign on finding 1 stands unchanged.
Lesson 6 (bar, inside guide): the revenue line sits inside the company's own pre-release, so finding 3 was cut from -0.5 to -0.3.

Lesson 2 (an unquantified reported-quarter impairment is the exception that has paid): the Q2 precedent fell about 19% on a pre-released quarter with an impairment, so finding 4 was raised from -0.8 to -1.0 and kept under reported_quarter.
Lesson 5 (an explained drawdown is not a positioning edge; positioning is the information set): the oversold positioning finding was cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 7: short interest checked at about 7% of shares and about 1 day of current volume, not crowded, so no shrink of the negatives.
Lesson 8 / rebuilt reaction history (sweep says the baseline history is untrustworthy): rebuilt from Q2 (about -19% premarket) and the Q3 pre-release (more than -10%); abs_move raised from 14 to 15.
